Sheet: Summary. Field: Summary. Field: How to use the Overtime Form template. Field: Purpose. Field: This template is governed by Regulations on working days and working hours. Field: It must be filled by Delivery Unit or Department heads ("DH" in the following). Field: It is kept and archived by the Compensation & Benefits responsible in the HR Department: Mrs. Hang (LHG) or "HR" in the following. Field: It only needs to be used when overtime work is planned at night, during week-ends or public holidays.. Field: Employee list. Field: Form "Employee List" must be filled first with the visa and name of all employees working overtime during the period. A maximum of 10 employees can be entered. In case more are necessary, use separate mission forms.
The Delivery Unit and project name must be specified.. Field: Overtime Planning. Field: 0 — Value: This form must be filled, printed and signed before the overtime work starts.. Field: 1 — Value: Fill-in the period (date from and to) that this planning covers. Field: 2 — Value: For each overtime window, enter the following:. Field: -  Visa of the employee (must be in the "Employee List" form). Field: -  Date. Field: -  Start time. Field: -  End time. Field: Notes:. Field: -  If the period spans across several days, enter one line per day. Field: -  The date must be within the planning period (specified in point 1 above) or it will turn red. Field: 3 — Value: Send the form to the requestor in CH and obtain approval. Field: 4 — Value: Print the form and the CH requestor's approval. Field: 5 — Value: All employees who appear in the "Employees prior consent" section sign. Field: 6 — Value: The DH signs. Field: 7 — Value: Submit the form together with the approval from the requestor in CH to HR both in electronic and in paper format.. Field: 8 — Value: HR will seek approval from the HR Manager and the General Director and inform the DH of the outcome. Field: 9 — Value: In case an update is necessary (employee sickness, resignation, change in business plans, etc...) that requires additional overtime work from any employee outside of normal working hours, the form must be updated and resubmitted for approval from CH, employees, HR and GD before the modified support date. 
Overtime  reductions or cancellations do not necessitate re-approval. 
Last-minute changes that cannot reasonably be pre-approved due to the urgent nature of the situation are approved by the DH the next day and communicated to HR.. Field: Overtime Actual Time. Field: 1 — Value: After the period, HR sends the "Overtime Actual Time" form to the DH. The form is pre-filled with the data from the approved "Overtime Planning" form.. Field: 2 — Value: Edit the pre-filled "Actual Time Spent" section if necessary (in case there are differences with the approved plan). Field: 3 — Value: Print the form. The DH signs it.. Field: 4 — Value: Submit the form to HR, both in electronic and in paper format.. Field: 5 — Value: Compensation will be paid to employees with the first payroll following the support period..
